usageNotes: Use this to update the human-readable description on an existing LXC snapshot — the only editable metadata after a snapshot is taken. The call is synchronous and returns null on success; no task UPID is issued. Requires VM.Snapshot privilege on /vms/{vmid}; the snapshot must already exist (use get_nodes_node_lxc_vmid_snapshot_snapname_config to verify before calling).

examples.summary: Add a description to an existing snapshot before a planned upgrade

params.description: Taken before Debian 12 dist-upgrade on 2024-09-15. Safe rollback point.

tips: This endpoint only accepts 'description' — snapshot name and creation time cannot be changed after creation.
Omitting 'description' or sending an empty string clears the existing description.
Snapshot names follow the pve-configid format (alphanumeric + underscore/hyphen, max 40 chars); verify the name with the list endpoint before updating.
Returns HTTP 200 with a null body on success — treat any non-200 as an error.
